cārikā.p: [Cara+ṇvu+ā] (thī) CL=10 Cāra+ṇika+ā. 'ṇika' has no meaning. ] Local tours; Going around. See original. Cārikā(thī) [cara+ṇvu+ā] A woman who wanders. See- Cāraka (1).
a: စာရ+ဏိက+အာ။ ဏိက အနက်မရှိ။]  လှည့်လည်-သွားလာ-ခြင်း၊ ဒေသစာရီလှည့်လည်ခြင်း၊ ဒေသစာရီကြွချီခြင်း။ မူရင်းကြည့်ပါ။ cārikā စာရိကာ(ထီ) [စရ+ဏွု+အာ]  လှည့်လည်-သွားလာ-သော မိန်းမ။ စာရက-(၁)-ကြည့်။

A: cārika：cāraka，cāraṇa a．m．n．旅行，遊行，徘徊．f．cārikā 遊行
F: Cārikā，【阴】旅程，游行，游荡。A．5．221．/III，257．︰“Pañcime bhikkhave，ādīnavā dīghacārikaṁ anavatthacārikaṁ anuyuttassa viharato．Katame pañca？ Assutaṁ na suṇāti，sutaṁ na pariyodāpeti，sutenekaccena avisārado hoti，gāḷhaṁ rogātaṅkaṁ phusati，na ca mittavā hoti．（诸比丘！这五种是屡次作长游行、无目的游行者之过失。以何为五？即：不闻未闻；已闻（心）不净化；於已闻的那一部分无自信；受重病患；及没有朋友。）
B:
cārikā：cārikā（thī）
စာရိကာ（ထီ）
[cara+ṇvu+ā]
[စရ+ဏွု+အာ]

cārikā：cārikā（thī）
စာရိကာ（ထီ）
[cara+ṇvu+ā．cāra+ṇika+ā．ṇika amarhi．]
[စရ+ဏွု+အာ။ စာရ+ဏိက+အာ။ ဏိက အနက်မရှိ။]
U: CĀRIKĀ：[f] cuộc hành trình，đi ta bà
Q: cārikā：các cuộc du hành hay bộ hành của tăng ni，kể cả đức phật，vào chín tháng ngoài mùa an cư trú mưa
K:
cārikā：စာရိကာ （ထီ）
[စရ+ဏွု+အာ။ စာရ+ဏိက+အာ။ ဏိက အနက်မရှိ။]
လှည့်လည်-သွားလာ-ခြင်း၊ ဒေသစာရီလှည့်လည်ခြင်း၊ ဒေသစာရီကြွချီခြင်း။ မူရင်းကြည့်ပါ။

cārikā：စာရိကာ （ထီ）
[စရ+ဏွု+အာ]
လှည့်လည်-သွားလာ-သော မိန်းမ။ စာရက-（၁）-ကြည့်။
R:
cārikā：စာရိကာ （ဣ）
လှည့်ပတ်သွားခြင်း။ ဒေသစာရီသွားခြင်း။
တထာဂတေ စာရိကံ ပက္ကနေ္တ၊ မြတ်စွာဘုရားသည် ဒေသစာရီ ကြွတော်မူသည်ရှိသော်။
DOP: cārika mf (~ā, ~ī) n. [cāri(n) + ka 2 ; cf BHS cārika], going about; living; practising; journeying around; a wandering ascetic ; Ap 519, 9 (nagare Haṃsavatiyā ~ī ās’ ahaṃ tadā ārāmena ca ārāmaṃ carāmi kusalatthikā, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se cārinī) = 527, 2 ( Be, Ee so; Ce, Se ~ā); — cārikā in Ee at Ps V 90, 4 (na piṇḍāya cārikā bhikkhū) is prob. wr; Be, Ce, Se nabhacārikā bhikkhū; — ifc see attha- ( sv attha 2 ), ākāsa- ( sv ākāsa 2 ), uñcha-, eka-, oka- ( sv oka 1 ), ti- ( sv ti 2 ), dvi-, nabha-, niketa-, pañca-, pure-.

cārikā ( and cāriyā ?) f. [ BHS cārikā; cf S. caryā], a going about; a journey, a tour ; Vin I 8, 10 (bhagavā … yena Bārāṇasī tena ~aṃ pakkāmi); D I 87, 3 (ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā Kosalesu ~aṃ caramāno; Sv 239, 20 foll. : ~aṃ caramāno ti addhānagamanaṃ gacchanto, ~ā ca nām’ esā bhagavato duvidhā hoti turitacārikā ca aturitacārikā ca); S I 105, 27 (caratha bhikkhave ~aṃ bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya … mā ekena dve agamittha; Spk I 171, 28 : ~an ti anupubbagamanacārikaṃ, divasaṃ yojanaparamaṃ gacchantā carathā ti vadati); Dhp 326 (idaṃ pure cittam acāri ~aṃ yenicchakaṃ) = Th 77; Sn 40 (vāse ṭhāne gamane ~āya; Pj II 85, 3 : janapadacārikāsaṅkhātāya ~āya) = Ap 8, 30 ; Ja II 394, 13 (bodhisatto … loṇambilasevanatthāya pabbatapādā otaritvā ~aṃ caramāno Bārāṇasiyaṃ patvā uyyāne vāsaṃ kappesi); III 492, 3* (cara ~aṃ lohitatuṇḍa); Ap 85, 20 (addhānaṃ paṭipannassa carato ~aṃ tadā); Mil 14, 23 (anupubbena ~aṃ caramāno); Kkh 2 332, 10 (~aṃ pakkamanan ti); Ps III 288, 20 (satthā … lokahitāya ~aṃ cari, yaṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ …, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr ~aṃ cariyaṃ); Dhp-a IV 24, 1 (cittaṃ nām’ etaṃ nānārammaṇesu dīgharattaṃ ~aṃ carantaṃ aniggaṇhantassa sotthibhāvo nāma natthi); Mhv 3:13 (Jambudīpamhi te therā vicaritvāna ~aṃ); 4:11 (Yasatthero caraṃ Vajjīsu ~aṃ); — cārikāya in Ee at Sv 601, 25 is wr for chārikāya ( Be, Ce, Se so ); — ifc see anavattha- ( sv avatthā ), ussada-, eka-, nibaddha- ( sv nibandhati ), vihāra-; — °- caraṇa , cārikacaraṇa, n. , going on a journey; making a tour ; Sp 962, 27 (uṭṭhehī ti bhagavato dhammadesanatthaṃ cārikacaraṇaṃ yācanto bhaṇati, Be so; Ee, Se cārikañcaraṇaṃ; not in Ce ) = Sv 471, 1 ( Be, Se so; Ce, Ee cārikaṃ caraṇaṃ) = Ps II 179, 4 ( Be so; Ce, Ee ~aṃ; Se cārikañcaraṇaṃ); Spk III 279, 16 (bhagavato hi ~aṃ pi aruṇuṭṭhāpanaṃ pi niyataṃ); — °(a)- pakkamana , n. , setting out on a journey ; Mp I 86, 21 (vinayapariyāyena nimantitassa vassāvāsaṃ vasitvā apaloketvā ~aṃ pavāretvā ~aṃ āgantukehi saddhiṃ paṭhamaṃ paṭisanthārakaraṇan ti idaṃ āciṇṇaṃ) = Sp 1279, 14 foll. ( eds cāriya-).
NCP: feminine a | caarikaa journey; a going about; a tour.
